upstream_note: the declared upstream 'fox_sports.com' does not resolve (underscores are invalid in DNS hostnames); the mirror targets the real FOX Sports service at www.foxsports.com, the same normalization precedent as the dblp mirror (declared parked domain -> real dblp.org)
capture_method: direct HTTP (requests/urllib, Chrome UA) against the live Nuxt-SSR pages of www.foxsports.com; no WAF, bot check or login wall was encountered; every captured page returned HTTP 200 and was stored as raw HTML in scraped_data/captures/ with per-page .meta.json sidecars (url, status, bytes, UTC timestamp)

www.foxsports.com.role: primary site: home, league hubs, standings, schedules, boxscores, rosters, stat leaders, player news, stories, shows, personalities, FOX Super 6, betting hub, NASCAR Cup standings, UFC results

images.role: team/league logos, story/show/personality artwork and headshots resolved from the captured pages' img and og:image URLs
images.note: every file was fetched from its upstream URL; no placeholders, duplicates or rescaled copies are used

source_data.teams.json: 214 teams (32 NFL, 30 MLB, 152 CFB from standings, poll and team-page links)
source_data.standings.json: NFL division tables, MLB division tables, CFB AP Top 25 poll
source_data.games.json: 315 games (finals with scores, schedules with odds) from boxscore pages and the scores/schedule hubs
source_data.game_details.json: per-game payloads: team stats, team leaders, starting QBs, key players, FOX facts, odds notes, probable pitchers, key plays, recent games, player news
source_data.team_info.json: per-team next-game lines, records, ranks, logos
source_data.player_news.json: 1433 player news items with impact blurbs
source_data.stories.json: 120 stories with bodies, authors, leagues, published timestamps; hub-card time-ago and source matched by title
source_data.nascar.json: NASCAR Cup standings, playoff grid, race schedule
source_data.super6.json: the Week 3 NFL Pick 6 card (six real final matchups) from the FOX Super 6 hub

deterministic_fixtures.super6_fixtures: each benchmark user has a graded entry in the frozen Week 3 Pick 6 (Alice 5/6, Bob 4/6, Carol 6/6 leader, Dana 3/6); new entries are graded against the captured results
deterministic_fixtures.favorites_fixtures: 23 favorited teams/players/shows/personalities spread across the four benchmark users
deterministic_fixtures.reproducibility: seed_data.py with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 rebuilds a byte-identical instance_seed/fox_sports.db from source_data/ (SQLite output is deterministic under the pinned toolchain)

not_captured: live-score polling endpoints and video streams (the mirror freezes the captured snapshot instead)
FOX Sports account system (replaced by the mirror's own deterministic accounts)
Bally Live / FOX One app-only surfaces
